description: Implement secure password reset flow with forgot-password email link, reset page with token validation, session invalidation on password change, and user notification email. Follow existing OtpService email template style.
steps: Create password_reset_tokens migration adding table with columns: email (string, index), token (string), created_at (timestamp) - Laravel default schema
Create app/Http/Controllers/Auth/ForgotPasswordController.php with showLinkRequestForm() and sendResetLink() methods using Laravel's Password facade

Create app/Http/Controllers/Auth/ResetPasswordController.php with showResetForm() and reset() methods that validate token, update password, invalidate all user sessions except current, and send confirmation email
Create resources/views/auth/forgot-password.blade.php following login.blade.php design pattern (two-panel layout with brand panel and form panel)
Create resources/views/auth/reset-password.blade.php with token-protected form following same design pattern

Create password reset email template in app/Notifications/ResetPasswordNotification.php using OtpService emailTemplate() style (Fraunces/DM Sans fonts, --ink, --trust-blue, --coral colors, gradient brand panel)
Create password changed notification email in app/Notifications/PasswordChangedNotification.php with same branded style alerting user of successful password reset
Add routes to routes/web.php: GET/POST /forgot-password, GET/POST /reset-password/{token}
Update login.blade.php 'Forgot password?' link to route('password.request')
On password reset, invalidate all existing sessions except current using Auth::logoutOtherDevices()
Test complete flow: request reset, receive email, click link, reset password, verify old password no longer works, verify notification email sent, verify all other sessions logged out
acceptance_criteria: User can request password reset via email on forgot-password page
Reset email contains secure token link valid for 60 minutes
Reset page validates token and allows password change with same strong password rules
After password reset, all other device sessions are invalidated
User receives confirmation email after successful password change
Old password no longer works after reset
All emails match existing Mwalimu brand style from OtpService
verification: Navigate to http://localhost:8000/login and click 'Forgot password?' link
Enter valid email and submit - verify redirect with success message
Check mailhog or logs for reset email with token link
Click reset link - verify redirect to reset-password page with token in URL
Enter new password and confirm - verify success message and redirect to login
Attempt login with old password - verify it fails
Attempt login with new password - verify it succeeds
Check for password changed notification email
Verify storage/logs/laravel.log shows no errors during flow
